newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Six hacked, shot dead in S.Africa's Zulu region.
newsitem.headline: Six hacked, shot dead in S.Africa's Zulu region.

text.p: Six people were hacked and shot to death while hundreds more were forced to flee their burning homes in South Africa's KwaZulu-Natal province at the weekend, police said on Tuesday.

The Sunday night attack on a community living near Umzinkulu in southern KwaZulu-Natal was to revenge the recent killing of a man in a neighbouring community, Umzinkulu police spokesman Captain Robert Peter told Reuters.
"Most of the victims had been killed with axes. Rifles were also used in the attack," Peter said.
Two women and four men, all adults, were murdered, he said.
About 100 huts were also razed by an unknown number of attackers, resulting in some 200 people fleeing the area.
Police reinforcements had been sent to the district, Peter said. No arrests had been made.

Supporters of the African National Congress and the rival Inkatha Freedom Party have fought a bloody turf war over the past decade that has killed some 15,000 people. The two parties have begun top-level peace talks to try to stem the violence.
